title.zh: 为什么 Solana 新的 250ms 提速实际上可能引发网络不稳定
title.en: Why Solana’s new 250ms speed boost could actually trigger network instability

current_state.zh: Solana 的 250ms slot time 已在 9 月 18 日 epoch 1037 生效；根据 Solana 工程 changelog 和 Solana Compass 报告，过渡时间约为 05:06 UTC。9 月 20 日一份覆盖 60 个一分钟窗口的早期样本观察到每个已产出 slot 约 266ms，epoch 1037 约跳过 0.05% 的计划 slot；报道称更重要的考验是 Solana 考虑有条件转向 200ms 时，leader 交接、交易转发、修复和多种验证者客户端能否保持可靠。
current_state.en: Solana’s 250ms slot time became effective at epoch 1037 on Sept. 18, according to the Solana engineering changelog and a Solana Compass report that placed the transition at about 05:06 UTC; an early Sept. 20 sample covering 60 one-minute windows observed about 266ms per produced slot, and epoch 1037 skipped about 0.05% of scheduled slots. The source says the more important test is whether leader handoffs, transaction forwarding, repair and multiple validator clients remain reliable as Solana considers a conditional move to 200ms.
